beamng.description: BeamNG.drive built-in Rally Mode. Uses OutGauge for dashboard telemetry and the local Rally bridge for stage and pacenote data.

bridge.installTooltip: Install or update the Rally bridge mod in the selected BeamNG user folder
bridge.ports: OutGauge target: 127.0.0.1:4444. ZTMZ Rally bridge target: 127.0.0.1:44445.
bridge.statusInstalled: Rally bridge installed. Restart BeamNG to load the updated mod.
bridge.statusWaiting: Rally bridge is listening on port {0}. In BeamNG's Mods Manager, enable ZTMZ Pacenote Rally Bridge, then enter a built-in Rally stage.
bridge.statusNoRecentData: Rally bridge was detected, but no recent data arrived on port {0}. Verify that ZTMZ Pacenote Rally Bridge is enabled, then reload the mod or restart BeamNG.
bridge.setupBridgeRequired: Install the Rally bridge before using BeamNG.drive Rally Mode with Pacenote Tool.
bridge.setupUserFolderRequired: Select a valid BeamNG.drive user folder before the Rally bridge can be installed.
